examples.zh: 我们在讨论功能前明确了利益相关方的需求。
examples.en: We clarified the stakeholder need before discussing features.

examples.zh: 访谈揭示了利益相关方加快审批的需求。
examples.en: The interview revealed a stakeholder need for faster approvals.

examples.zh: 发起人为试点确定了一项业务目标。
examples.en: The sponsor defined a business objective for the pilot.

examples.zh: 我们的业务目标是减少退单。
examples.en: Our business objective is to reduce returned orders.

examples.zh: 更好的问题界定使团队专注于真正的限制因素。
examples.en: Better problem framing kept the team focused on the real constraint.

examples.zh: 问题界定帮助我们区分症状与原因。
examples.en: Problem framing helped us distinguish symptoms from causes.

examples.zh: 团队描述了夜班的一个使用场景。
examples.en: The team described a usage scenario for the night shift.

examples.zh: 这个使用场景假定操作员戴着手套。
examples.en: This usage scenario assumes the operator wears gloves.

examples.zh: 设计必须适应工厂的运行约束。
examples.en: The design must work within the plant's operating constraints.

examples.zh: 通风有限是这个房间的运行约束。
examples.en: Limited ventilation is an operating constraint for this room.

examples.zh: 质量部门批准将该安全要求作为设计输入。
examples.en: Quality approved the safety requirement as a design input.

examples.zh: 将温度上限记录为设计输入。
examples.en: Record the temperature limit as a design input.

examples.zh: 每项验收条件都必须可观察、可测试。
examples.en: Each acceptance condition must be observable and testable.

examples.zh: 验收条件要求清洗后标签仍可读。
examples.en: The acceptance condition requires readable labels after washing.

examples.zh: 我们将仪表板重新设计记为范围外事项。
examples.en: We recorded the dashboard redesign as an out-of-scope item.

examples.zh: 本季度移动端支持仍属于范围外事项。
examples.en: Mobile support remains an out-of-scope item this quarter.

examples.zh: 计划员在每次客户通话后更新假设清单。
examples.en: The planner updates the assumption log after each customer call.

examples.zh: 把预计订单量加入假设清单。
examples.en: Add the expected order volume to the assumption log.

examples.zh: 我们在发布图纸前解决了接口依赖。
examples.en: We resolved the interface dependency before releasing the drawing.

examples.zh: 接口依赖将我们的扫描器与他们的数据库关联起来。
examples.en: An interface dependency links our scanner to their database.

examples.zh: 团队提交了附带成本影响的范围变更提案。
examples.en: The team submitted a scope change proposal with cost impacts.

examples.zh: 范围变更提案增加了仓库员工培训。
examples.en: The scope change proposal adds training for warehouse staff.

examples.zh: 更改连接器前先评估下游影响。
examples.en: Assess the downstream effect before changing the connector.

examples.zh: 较小的纸箱可能对后续堆垛产生影响。
examples.en: A smaller carton may have a downstream effect on stacking.

examples.zh: 客户批准后，我们冻结了需求基线。
examples.en: We froze the requirements baseline after customer approval.

examples.zh: 将新请求与需求基线进行比较。
examples.en: Compare the new request against the requirements baseline.

examples.zh: 工程师在评审后更新了追溯矩阵。
examples.en: The engineer updated the traceability matrix after the review.

examples.zh: 追溯矩阵将每项需求与一项测试关联。
examples.en: The traceability matrix links each requirement to a test.

examples.zh: 已发布的规格书是受控配置项。
examples.en: The released specification is a controlled configuration item.

examples.zh: 为每个配置项分配唯一编号。
examples.en: Assign a unique number to each configuration item.

examples.zh: 使用作业指导书前先检查修订历史。
examples.en: Check the revision history before using the work instruction.

examples.zh: 修订历史说明了检验步骤更改的原因。
examples.en: The revision history explains why the inspection step changed.

examples.zh: 变更在发布前必须遵循审批流程。
examples.en: The change must follow the approval workflow before release.

examples.zh: 审批流程先将合同送交法务。
examples.en: The approval workflow sends contracts to legal first.

examples.zh: 紧急会议前先确认谁拥有变更批准权。
examples.en: Confirm the change authority before the emergency meeting.

examples.zh: 变更批准方否决了拟议的材料替换。
examples.en: The change authority rejected the proposed material substitution.

examples.zh: 客户批准了二十件产品的偏离安排。
examples.en: The customer granted an authorized deviation for twenty units.

examples.zh: 这项获准偏离于六月底到期。
examples.en: This authorized deviation expires at the end of June.

examples.zh: 工程部门在出货前审查了豁免申请。
examples.en: Engineering reviewed the waiver request before shipment.

examples.zh: 豁免申请说明了无法进行测试的原因。
examples.en: The waiver request explains why the test cannot run.

examples.zh: 我们在估算工作量前建立了工作分解结构。
examples.en: We built a work breakdown structure before estimating effort.

examples.zh: 工作分解结构将安装与操作员培训分开。
examples.en: The work breakdown structure separates installation from operator training.

examples.zh: 计划员每天早上监控次关键路径。
examples.en: The planner monitors the near-critical path every morning.

examples.zh: 夹具延误可能使次关键路径变成关键路径。
examples.en: A delayed fixture could make the near-critical path critical.

examples.zh: 延迟的图纸消耗了三天的进度浮动时间。
examples.en: The late drawing consumed three days of schedule float.

examples.zh: 出货前我们有两天的进度浮动时间。
examples.en: We have two days of schedule float before shipment.

examples.zh: 计划列明了每项外部里程碑依赖。
examples.en: The plan exposes every external milestone dependency.

examples.zh: 客户批准是模具放行的里程碑依赖条件。
examples.en: Customer approval is a milestone dependency for tooling release.

examples.zh: 前置活动完成后才能开始测试。
examples.en: Testing cannot start until the predecessor activity is complete.

examples.zh: 校准是这项测量任务的前置活动。
examples.en: Calibration is the predecessor activity for this measurement task.

examples.zh: 我们增加了产能以保障后续活动。
examples.en: We added capacity to protect the successor activity.

examples.zh: 将延误告知后续活动的负责人。
examples.en: Notify the owner of the successor activity about delays.

examples.zh: 团队在承诺六月交付前评估了工期压缩。
examples.en: The team evaluated schedule compression before promising June.

examples.zh: 工期压缩需要另一支合格的检验团队。
examples.en: Schedule compression would require another qualified inspection team.

examples.zh: 快速跟进节省了时间，但增加了协调风险。
examples.en: Fast tracking saved time but increased coordination risk.

examples.zh: 快速跟进法让包装设计与原型测试部分并行。
examples.en: Fast tracking lets packaging design overlap with prototype testing.

examples.zh: 我们考虑通过赶工缩短资格验证阶段的工期。
examples.en: We considered crashing the schedule for the qualification phase.

examples.zh: 采用赶工法会增加加班费和租赁费。
examples.en: Crashing the schedule would add overtime and rental costs.

examples.zh: 资源平衡把两项测试移到了下一周。
examples.en: Resource leveling moved two tests into the following week.

examples.zh: 资源平衡避免唯一的振动测试仪被重复预订。
examples.en: Resource leveling prevents double-booking the only vibration tester.

examples.zh: 在邀请中说明会议目标。
examples.en: State the meeting objective in the invitation.

examples.zh: 我们的会议目标是选定一种运输方案。
examples.en: Our meeting objective is to select one shipping option.

examples.zh: 主持人准备了一份列有两个明确选项的决策议程。
examples.en: The chair prepared a decision agenda with two clear options.

examples.zh: 决策议程包含预算表决。
examples.en: The decision agenda includes a vote on the budget.

examples.zh: 我们把讨论时间限制为十五分钟吧。
examples.en: Let's timebox the discussion to fifteen minutes.

examples.zh: 我们应将每家供应商的介绍限为五分钟。
examples.en: We should timebox supplier introductions to five minutes each.

examples.zh: 我们把定价模型加入了暂缓讨论清单。
examples.en: We added the pricing model to the deferred discussion list.

examples.zh: 把人员配置问题放入暂缓讨论清单。
examples.en: Put staffing questions on the deferred discussion list.

examples.zh: 引导员组织了关于风险的轮流发言讨论。
examples.en: The facilitator ran a round-robin discussion on the risks.

examples.zh: 轮流发言讨论让较沉默的工程师有机会发言。
examples.en: A round-robin discussion gave quieter engineers time to speak.

examples.zh: 我们为冲突协调会议指定了一名中立引导员。
examples.en: We appointed a neutral facilitator for the conflict session.

examples.zh: 引导员请大家将事实与假设分开。
examples.en: The facilitator asked everyone to separate facts from assumptions.

examples.zh: 会议记录记下了关于上线日期的不同意见。
examples.en: The minutes recorded a dissenting view about the launch date.

examples.zh: 她的不同意见促成了第二次安全评审。
examples.en: Her dissenting view prompted a second safety review.

examples.zh: 我们在继续前确认了每个共识点。
examples.en: We confirmed each point of agreement before moving on.

examples.zh: 成本透明是第一个共识点。
examples.en: Cost transparency was the first point of agreement.

examples.zh: 主持人明确了争议点，以便集中辩论。
examples.en: The chair isolated the point of contention for a focused debate.

examples.zh: 付款时间仍是主要争议点。
examples.en: Payment timing remains the main point of contention.

examples.zh: 请用一句话概括会议要点。
examples.en: Please summarize the meeting takeaway in one sentence.

examples.zh: 我从会议得到的主要结论是需要现场数据。
examples.en: My main meeting takeaway was the need for field data.

examples.zh: 我们在政策变更前梳理了相关方全貌。
examples.en: We mapped the stakeholder landscape before the policy change.

examples.zh: 相关方全貌涵盖经销商和当地服务团队。
examples.en: The stakeholder landscape includes distributors and local service teams.

examples.zh: 团队用影响力关注度矩阵规划参与沟通。
examples.en: The team used an influence-interest grid to plan engagement.

examples.zh: 将区域经理标在影响力关注度矩阵上。
examples.en: Place the regional manager on the influence-interest grid.

examples.zh: 我们与发起人确定了每周沟通的节奏。
examples.en: We set a weekly communication cadence with the sponsor.

examples.zh: 工厂搬迁期间，每日沟通的节奏发挥了作用。
examples.en: A daily communication cadence helped during the factory move.

examples.zh: 我们在更改优先顺序前取得了发起人的共识。
examples.en: We secured sponsor alignment before changing priorities.

examples.zh: 取消试点前需要与发起人达成共识。
examples.en: Sponsor alignment is needed before we cancel the pilot.

examples.zh: 每家供应商都指定了处理日常问题的执行层联系人。
examples.en: Each supplier named a working-level contact for daily issues.

examples.zh: 将交货问题发给我们采购部门的执行层联系人。
examples.en: Send delivery questions to our working-level contact in purchasing.

examples.zh: 我们就灭菌风险咨询了一位领域专家。
examples.en: We consulted a domain specialist about the sterilization risk.

examples.zh: 一位领域专家审查了胶黏剂固化要求。
examples.en: A domain specialist reviewed the adhesive curing requirements.

examples.zh: 团队开放了十天的征询意见期。
examples.en: The team opened a ten-day consultation window.

examples.zh: 征询意见期在下次设计评审前结束。
examples.en: The consultation window closes before the next design review.

examples.zh: 我们通过展示改动完成了反馈闭环。
examples.en: We closed the feedback loop by showing what changed.

examples.zh: 每周操作员访谈为设计人员建立反馈闭环。
examples.en: Weekly operator interviews create a feedback loop for designers.

examples.zh: 及早设定预期减少了最后一刻的升级处理。
examples.en: Early expectation setting reduced last-minute escalation.

examples.zh: 预期设定应涵盖响应时间和支持时段。
examples.en: Expectation setting should cover response times and support hours.

examples.zh: 我们发现成本透明是主要阻力点。
examples.en: We identified cost transparency as the main resistance point.

examples.zh: 额外的文书工作成了班组长抵触的点。
examples.en: Extra paperwork became a resistance point for shift leaders.

examples.zh: 使用获批的登记簿作为权威记录。
examples.en: Use the approved register as the authoritative record.

examples.zh: 签署的测试报告是我们的权威记录。
examples.en: The signed test report is our authoritative record.

examples.zh: 在程序文件发布前指定文件负责人。
examples.en: Assign a document owner before the procedure is released.

examples.zh: 文件负责人必须每年检查过时的引用。
examples.en: The document owner must review obsolete references each year.

examples.zh: 电子签名加强了版本控制。
examples.en: Electronic signatures strengthened revision control.

examples.zh: 版本控制防止操作员使用旧版图纸。
examples.en: Revision control prevents operators from using outdated drawings.

examples.zh: 法务完成了新条款的修订标记审阅。
examples.en: Legal completed a redline review of the new terms.

examples.zh: 修订标记审阅发现了未经批准的保修期延长。
examples.en: A redline review revealed an unapproved warranty extension.

examples.zh: 将批准记录与已发布图纸一同保存。
examples.en: Retain an approval record with the released drawing.

examples.zh: 批准记录列明两位审阅人及决定日期。
examples.en: The approval record names both reviewers and the decision date.

examples.zh: 报告保留了从测试到决策的证据链。
examples.en: The report preserves the evidence chain from test to decision.

examples.zh: 缺少校准记录使该结果的证据链中断。
examples.en: Missing calibration records broke the evidence chain for this result.

examples.zh: 工程师离职前，我们规划了知识转移。
examples.en: We planned the knowledge transfer before the engineer left.

examples.zh: 知识转移包括在实际机器上接受指导练习。
examples.en: Knowledge transfer includes supervised practice on the actual machine.

examples.zh: 她为接任的项目负责人写了一份交接说明。
examples.en: She wrote a handover note for the incoming project lead.

examples.zh: 交接说明列出了未结索赔和客户联系人。
examples.en: The handover note lists open claims and customer contacts.

examples.zh: 趁背景仍清楚时记录决策理由。
examples.en: Document the decision rationale while the context is fresh.

examples.zh: 决策理由说明了我们为何选择较慢的路线。
examples.en: The decision rationale explains why we chose the slower route.

examples.zh: 供应商恢复正常后，团队总结了经验教训。
examples.en: The team captured lessons learned after the supplier recovery.

examples.zh: 规划下次工厂搬迁时应用这些经验教训。
examples.en: Apply the lessons learned when planning the next plant move.

examples.zh: 控制目标是防止未经授权的发布。
examples.en: The control objective is to prevent unauthorized releases.

examples.zh: 我们的控制目标是发现向供应商重复付款。
examples.en: Our control objective is to detect duplicate supplier payments.

examples.zh: 审计员将每月访问权限审查作为一项控制活动进行测试。
examples.en: The auditor tested the monthly access review as a control activity.

examples.zh: 核对收货单与发票是一项常规控制活动。
examples.en: Matching receipts to invoices is a routine control activity.

examples.zh: 负责人用签署记录回应了证据请求。
examples.en: The owner responded to the evidence request with signed records.

examples.zh: 证据请求明确要求两个班次的培训记录。
examples.en: The evidence request specifies training logs from both shifts.

examples.zh: 团队用经核实的证据关闭了审计发现。
examples.en: The team closed the audit finding with verified evidence.

examples.zh: 这项审计发现涉及温度监测记录缺失。
examples.en: This audit finding concerns missing temperature monitoring records.

examples.zh: 质量部门针对包装流程提出了一项不符合项。
examples.en: Quality raised a nonconformity against the packing process.

examples.zh: 在这里，未签署的放行表构成不符合项。
examples.en: An unsigned release form constitutes a nonconformity here.

examples.zh: 审计员记录了一项关于培训记录的观察项。
examples.en: The auditor recorded an observation about training records.

examples.zh: 该观察项建议留样标签应更清晰。
examples.en: The observation recommends clearer labels on retained samples.

examples.zh: 管理层批准了一项设有三个里程碑的整改计划。
examples.en: Management approved a remediation plan with three milestones.

examples.zh: 整改计划为所有逾期检验指定了负责人。
examples.en: The remediation plan assigns owners to all overdue inspections.

examples.zh: 引入经销商前，我们进行了尽职调查。
examples.en: We performed due diligence before onboarding the distributor.

examples.zh: 尽职调查发现拟合作伙伴仍有未解决的投诉。
examples.en: Due diligence revealed unresolved complaints against the proposed partner.

examples.zh: 标签变更必须符合新的法规要求。
examples.en: The label change must meet the new regulatory requirement.

examples.zh: 请合格的当地顾问核实该法规要求。
examples.en: Verify the regulatory requirement with a qualified local adviser.

examples.zh: 评审按市场评估了合规差距。
examples.en: The review assessed the compliance gap by market.

examples.zh: 该合规差距涉及记录保存期限。
examples.en: The compliance gap concerns how long records are retained.

examples.zh: 谈判价格前，我们需要了解成本结构。
examples.en: We need to understand the cost structure before negotiating price.

examples.zh: 人工和模具在这家供应商的成本结构中占主要部分。
examples.en: Labor and tooling dominate this supplier's cost structure.

examples.zh: 财务将已承诺成本与实际支出分开追踪。
examples.en: Finance tracks committed cost separately from actual spend.

examples.zh: 已签署的设备订单增加了我们的已承诺成本。
examples.en: The signed equipment order increased our committed cost.

examples.zh: 模型估算了各情景下随数量变动的成本。
examples.en: The model estimates volume-dependent cost for each scenario.

examples.zh: 在这份估算中，包装是随数量变动的成本。
examples.en: Packaging is a volume-dependent cost in this estimate.

examples.zh: 我们比较了周末生产的增量成本。
examples.en: We compared the incremental cost of weekend production.

examples.zh: 增量成本包括批次之间的额外清洁费用。
examples.en: The incremental cost includes additional cleaning between batches.

examples.zh: 考虑将试生产线用于返工的机会成本。
examples.en: Consider the opportunity cost of using the pilot line for rework.

examples.zh: 失去的原型制作时间是这次返工的机会成本。
examples.en: Lost prototype time is the opportunity cost of this rework.

examples.zh: 这项投资在十八个月后达到盈亏平衡点。
examples.en: The investment reaches the break-even point after eighteen months.

examples.zh: 销量降低会推迟盈亏平衡点。
examples.en: Lower sales volume would delay the break-even point.

examples.zh: 财务算出的投资回收期为两年。
examples.en: Finance calculated a two-year payback period.

examples.zh: 投资回收期不计收回初始投资之后的收益。
examples.en: The payback period excludes any benefit after initial recovery.

examples.zh: 委员会比较了三个方案的净现值。
examples.en: The committee compared net present value across three options.

examples.zh: 更高的折现率降低了项目的净现值。
examples.en: A higher discount rate reduced the project's net present value.

examples.zh: 负责人用支持数据解释了预算差异。
examples.en: The owner explained the budget variance with supporting data.

examples.zh: 额外运费解释了大部分预算差异。
examples.en: Extra freight charges explain most of the budget variance.

examples.zh: 我们每月按产品系列衡量预测误差。
examples.en: We measure forecast error by product family each month.

examples.zh: 客户推迟几笔订单后，预测误差增大了。
examples.en: Forecast error increased after the customer postponed several orders.

examples.zh: 我们将试点范围限定为一条生产线和两种产品。
examples.en: We limited the pilot scope to one line and two products.

examples.zh: 试点范围不包括需要特殊出口文件的订单。
examples.en: The pilot scope excludes orders requiring special export documents.

examples.zh: 团队针对延误提出了一个可检验假设。
examples.en: The team formed a testable hypothesis about the delay.

examples.zh: 我们需要针对标签反复失效提出可检验假设。
examples.en: We need a testable hypothesis about repeated label failures.

examples.zh: 选择指标前先说明学习目标。
examples.en: State the learning objective before selecting metrics.

examples.zh: 我们的学习目标是了解夜间队列增长情况。
examples.en: Our learning objective is to understand overnight queue growth.

examples.zh: 质量部门在采集数据前审查了实验设计。
examples.en: Quality reviewed the experiment design before data collection.

examples.zh: 实验设计使所有轮次保持相同温度。
examples.en: The experiment design keeps temperature constant across all runs.

examples.zh: 选择一个体现客户价值的成功指标。
examples.en: Choose a success metric that reflects customer value.

examples.zh: 一次验收通过率是本次试验的主要成功指标。
examples.en: First-pass acceptance is our main success metric for this trial.

examples.zh: 试验开始前先定义失败判据。
examples.en: Define a failure criterion before the trial starts.

examples.zh: 任何外壳开裂都满足本次测试的失败判据。
examples.en: Any cracked housing meets the failure criterion for this test.

examples.zh: 我们选择了需求模式相似的对照组。
examples.en: We selected a comparison group with similar demand patterns.

examples.zh: 对照组继续使用原来的包装方法。
examples.en: The comparison group continued using the original packing method.

examples.zh: 推广结果前先检查是否存在样本偏差。
examples.en: Check for sample bias before generalizing the result.

examples.zh: 排除夜班可能给研究引入样本偏差。
examples.en: Excluding night shifts could introduce sample bias into the study.

examples.zh: 班次人员的经验可能是试验中的混杂因素。
examples.en: Shift experience may be a confounding factor in the trial.

examples.zh: 操作员培训是本次比较中的混杂因素。
examples.en: Operator training is a confounding factor in this comparison.

examples.zh: 扩大样本后，分析员发布了证据更新。
examples.en: The analyst issued an evidence update after the larger sample.

examples.zh: 证据更新包含第二家工厂的测量数据。
examples.en: The evidence update includes measurements from the second factory.

examples.zh: 承运人在装货后签发了提单。
examples.en: The carrier issued the bill of lading after loading.

examples.zh: 银行要求提供提单正本。
examples.en: The bank requested the original bill of lading.

examples.zh: 仓库将装箱单与纸箱逐一核对。
examples.en: The warehouse checked the packing list against the cartons.

examples.zh: 装箱单列出了每个木箱的重量。
examples.en: The packing list shows the weight of each crate.

examples.zh: 出口商为报关准备了商业发票。
examples.en: The exporter prepared a commercial invoice for customs.

examples.zh: 请更正商业发票上的币种。
examples.en: Please correct the currency on the commercial invoice.

examples.zh: 我们在启运前取得了原产地证书。
examples.en: We obtained a certificate of origin before departure.

examples.zh: 进口商要求提供签署的原产地证书。
examples.en: The importer asked for a signed certificate of origin.

examples.zh: 报关代理在一天内完成了清关。
examples.en: The broker completed customs clearance within one day.

examples.zh: 产品资料缺失延误了港口清关。
examples.en: Missing product details delayed customs clearance at the port.

examples.zh: 我们为紧急货件指定了一家货运代理。
examples.en: We appointed a freight forwarder for the urgent shipment.

examples.zh: 货运代理订好了明天航班的舱位。
examples.en: The freight forwarder booked space on tomorrow's flight.

examples.zh: 比较运费报价前先确认国际贸易术语。
examples.en: Confirm the incoterm before comparing freight quotes.

examples.zh: 合同必须注明国际贸易术语及指定地点。
examples.en: The contract must identify the incoterm and named place.

examples.zh: 报关代理核实了新零件的关税税率。
examples.en: The broker verified the duty rate for the new component.

examples.zh: 计算到岸总成本前先确认关税税率。
examples.en: Confirm the duty rate before calculating the landed cost.

examples.zh: 本月合并运输降低了空运成本。
examples.en: Shipment consolidation reduced airfreight cost this month.

examples.zh: 合并运输要求两家供应商赶上同一截单时间。
examples.en: Shipment consolidation requires both suppliers to meet one cutoff.

examples.zh: 客户为丢失的纸箱索取签收证明。
examples.en: The customer requested proof of delivery for the missing carton.

examples.zh: 快递员上传了附有签名的签收证明。
examples.en: The courier uploaded proof of delivery with a signature.

examples.zh: 团队将批发价格作为早期成本信号进行追踪。
examples.en: The team tracks wholesale prices as an early cost signal.

examples.zh: 我们的批发价格不含零售商的配送费。
examples.en: Our wholesale price excludes the retailer's delivery charge.

examples.zh: 该机构今天早上发布了生产者价格指数。
examples.en: The agency released the producer price index this morning.

examples.zh: 分析员比较了各行业生产者价格指数的变化。
examples.en: The analyst compared producer price index changes across sectors.

examples.zh: 投入品价格明显高于预测水平。
examples.en: Input prices ran substantially hotter than the forecast.

examples.zh: 服务通胀可能明显高于我们的基准预测。
examples.en: Service inflation could run substantially hotter than our baseline.

examples.zh: 报告在数据发布前调查了专业预测人员。
examples.en: The report surveyed professional forecasters before the release.

examples.zh: 预测人员在客户访谈后修订了需求估计。
examples.en: The forecaster revised her demand estimate after customer interviews.

examples.zh: 最初的成本前景相对温和。
examples.en: The initial cost outlook was relatively benign.

examples.zh: 目前看来，修订后的运输前景相对温和。
examples.en: The revised shipping outlook looks relatively benign for now.

examples.zh: 执行不力可能浪费原有的有利条件。
examples.en: Poor execution can throw away a favorable inheritance.

examples.zh: 忽视维护可能挥霍前人留下的可靠设备优势。
examples.en: Neglecting maintenance could throw away an inheritance of reliable equipment.

examples.zh: 需求仍在上升，近期看不到缓解迹象。
examples.en: With demand still rising, there is no relief visible in the near future.

examples.zh: 订单不断积压，看不到缓解迹象。
examples.en: With orders piling up, there is no relief visible.

examples.zh: 燃料成本上涨可能向整个经济传导。
examples.en: Higher fuel costs can cascade through the economy.

examples.zh: 能源价格剧烈冲击可能向整个经济传导。
examples.en: A sharp energy shock may cascade through the economy.

examples.zh: 石油产品价格影响许多运输成本。
examples.en: Prices of petroleum products affect many transport costs.

examples.zh: 仓库将石油产品存放在分开标识的储罐中。
examples.en: The depot stores petroleum products in separate marked tanks.

examples.zh: 停产使炼油厂产出中断了数天。
examples.en: The outage disrupted refinery output for several days.

examples.zh: 炼油厂安排了最旧加工装置的维护。
examples.en: The refinery scheduled maintenance for its oldest processing unit.

examples.zh: 运费仍显著高于去年。
examples.en: Freight rates remain significantly higher than last year.

examples.zh: 维修成本仍显著高于我们的最初估算。
examples.en: Repair costs remain significantly higher than our original estimate.

examples.zh: 我们在中断最严重时获得了额外产能。
examples.en: We secured extra capacity at the height of the disruption.

examples.zh: 她在召回最紧张时加入了团队。
examples.en: She joined the team at the height of the recall.

examples.zh: 今天我们连一个批号都核实不了，更不用说整批了。
examples.en: We cannot verify one lot today, let alone the full batch.

examples.zh: 我们连十个托盘都放不下，更不用说五十个。
examples.en: We lack space for ten pallets, let alone fifty.

examples.zh: 本季度以糟糕的交付表现告终。
examples.en: The quarter ended with dismal delivery performance.

examples.zh: 试验在潮湿条件下的结果很糟糕。
examples.en: The trial produced dismal results under humid conditions.

examples.zh: 确认产能前不要作出夸张的承诺。
examples.en: Do not make an extravagant promise before checking capacity.

examples.zh: 期限延误时，夸张的承诺会损害信任。
examples.en: An extravagant promise can undermine trust when deadlines slip.

examples.zh: 尽管进度延误，他们仍反复坚称计划未受影响。
examples.en: They keep insisting that the plan is intact despite the slips.

examples.zh: 他们反复坚称没有必要增加测试。
examples.en: They keep insisting that extra testing is unnecessary.

examples.zh: 我们无法排除供应商延误的可能性。
examples.en: We cannot rule out the possibility of a supplier delay.

examples.zh: 这些记录排除了重复发货的可能性。
examples.en: These records rule out the possibility of a duplicate shipment.

examples.zh: 评审认为后一种可能性更大。
examples.en: The review considered the latter possibility more likely.

examples.zh: 我们讨论了损坏和误贴标签；先调查后一种可能性。
examples.en: We discussed damage and mislabeling; investigate the latter possibility first.

examples.zh: 警报没有触发，大概是因为传感器离线了。
examples.en: The alert failed, presumably because the sensor was offline.

examples.zh: 木箱被移走了，大概是为了腾出通道。
examples.en: The crate was moved, presumably to clear the aisle.

examples.zh: 将目标与实际结果作比较是一种范畴错误。
examples.en: Comparing a target with an actual result is a category error.

examples.zh: 把预测当作保证是一种范畴错误。
examples.en: Treating a forecast as a guarantee is a category error.

V20261017-120.editorialNote: 原例句保留用于核对来源；将目标与实际结果作比较通常并不构成范畴错误，学习用法请参考第二条例句。

examples.zh: 调查通过保留的记录寻求客观事实。
examples.en: The investigation seeks objective truth from preserved records.

examples.zh: 时间戳提供了关于批准时间的客观事实。
examples.en: The timestamp offers objective truth about when approval occurred.

examples.zh: 访问控制限制了获批记录的可变性。
examples.en: Access controls limit the mutability of the approved record.

examples.zh: 数据库设计仅允许在最终批准前更改数据。
examples.en: The database design allows mutability only before final approval.

examples.zh: 在极权政权下，独立记录尤其容易受到威胁。
examples.en: Independent records are especially vulnerable under a totalitarian regime.

examples.zh: 这部小说描写了极权政权下的日常生活。
examples.en: The novel portrays daily life under a totalitarian regime.

examples.zh: 薄弱的监督可能纵容错误决策。
examples.en: Bad decisions can be enabled by weak oversight.

examples.zh: 同事的沉默可能纵容管理者继续那种行为。
examples.en: Managers can be enabled in that behavior by silent colleagues.

examples.zh: 规则突然变更引发了一波投诉。
examples.en: The sudden rule change generated a wave of complaints.

examples.zh: 这项公告可能引发一波取消申请。
examples.en: The announcement could generate a wave of cancellation requests.
